description: Hand-verified capability inventory for Markor (net.gsantner.markor), version 2.16.1.

features.name: Browse the notebook folder
features.description: Browse the notebook folder as documented for Markor.
actions: the Files tab opens at the configured notebook root
tap a folder to enter it
tap the up arrow or the breadcrumb path to move back up

features.name: Create a new plain text or Markdown document
features.description: Create a new plain text or Markdown document as documented for Markor.

features.name: Create a document from a template
features.description: Create a document from a template as documented for Markor.
actions: choose a template (for example empty file, Markdown reference, to-do list, Zim page or a user template)

features.name: Create a folder
features.description: Create a folder as documented for Markor.

features.name: Edit a document in the text editor
features.description: Edit a document in the text editor as documented for Markor.
actions: tap the back arrow or the save icon; changes are stored to the file

features.name: Switch between edit mode and rendered preview
features.description: Switch between edit mode and rendered preview as documented for Markor.
actions: tap the preview/eye icon in the toolbar
tap the icon again (or the edit pencil) to return to editing

features.name: Apply Markdown formatting with the action toolbar
features.description: Apply Markdown formatting with the action toolbar as documented for Markor.
actions: place the cursor or select text
tap an icon on the format action bar below the editor (bold, italic, strikethrough, heading level, code, quote, horizontal rule)
the syntax is inserted around the selection

features.name: Insert bullet, numbered and checkbox lists
features.description: Insert bullet, numbered and checkbox lists as documented for Markor.
actions: position the cursor on the line
tap the list, numbered list or checkbox action in the action bar
continue typing; pressing Enter continues the list automatically

features.name: Insert a link
features.description: Insert a link as documented for Markor.
actions: tap the link action in the action bar
enter or pick the target path or URL
confirm; the Markdown link syntax is inserted

features.name: Insert an image from the gallery or camera
features.description: Insert an image from the gallery or camera as documented for Markor.
actions: tap the image/attachment action in the action bar
choose "Take a picture", "Pick from gallery" or "Select a file"
the image is copied into the attachment folder and the Markdown image reference is inserted

features.name: Record and insert an audio note
features.description: Record and insert an audio note as documented for Markor.
actions: the recording is saved and linked in the document

features.name: Insert the current date or time
features.description: Insert the current date or time as documented for Markor.
actions: tap the date/time action in the action bar
select the required format from the list (or long-press to configure the default format)
the timestamp is inserted at the cursor

features.name: Insert a table
features.description: Insert a table as documented for Markor.
actions: tap the table action in the action bar

features.name: Undo and redo edits
features.description: Undo and redo edits as documented for Markor.
actions: tap the undo arrow in the toolbar to revert the last change
tap the redo arrow to reapply it

features.name: Search inside the open document
features.description: Search inside the open document as documented for Markor.
actions: tap the search icon in the editor toolbar

features.name: Search across all files in the notebook
features.description: Search across all files in the notebook as documented for Markor.
actions: tap the search icon in the toolbar
choose whether to search file names only or file contents
tap a result to open it

features.name: Open the QuickNote file
features.description: Open the QuickNote file as documented for Markor.
actions: Tap the QuickNote tab in the bottom navigation bar (or open it from the drawer)
the dedicated QuickNote document opens directly in the editor

features.name: Open the To-Do file
features.description: Open the To-Do file as documented for Markor.
actions: Tap the To-Do tab in the bottom navigation bar
the dedicated to-do document opens in the editor

features.name: Manage a todo.txt file
features.description: Manage a todo.txt file as documented for Markor.
actions: Open or create a .txt file in todo.txt format
use the actions to add a priority, a project (+), a context (@), a due date or to mark a line done
tap the sort action to reorder by priority, due date, project or context

features.name: Edit a Zim Wiki page
features.description: Edit a Zim Wiki page as documented for Markor.
actions: Open a file with the Zim Wiki extension/format
use the heading, bold, italic, checkbox and link actions
tap the preview icon to see the rendered page

features.name: Edit AsciiDoc, Org-Mode, CSV and plain text files
features.description: Edit AsciiDoc, Org-Mode, CSV and plain text files as documented for Markor.
actions: Open a file with the corresponding extension
Markor selects the matching syntax highlighting and action bar
use the preview toggle where a renderer is available

features.name: Preview a CSV file as a table
features.description: Preview a CSV file as a table as documented for Markor.
actions: the delimited data is rendered as a table

features.name: Create a Markdown presentation
features.description: Create a Markdown presentation as documented for Markor.
actions: Create or open a Markdown file containing the presentation front-matter/slide separators
swipe or tap to advance between slides

features.name: Export the document as a PDF or print it
features.description: Export the document as a PDF or print it as documented for Markor.
actions: select the printer or "Save as PDF"

features.name: Share the document as plain text or rendered HTML
features.description: Share the document as plain text or rendered HTML as documented for Markor.
actions: choose to share the raw text, the rendered HTML or the file itself

features.name: Rename a file or folder
features.description: Rename a file or folder as documented for Markor.
actions: long-press the item to select it
tap the rename action in the contextual toolbar

features.name: Move or copy files and folders
features.description: Move or copy files and folders as documented for Markor.
actions: tap the move or copy action

features.name: Delete files and folders
features.description: Delete files and folders as documented for Markor.
actions: long-press the items to select them

features.name: Select multiple files at once
features.description: Select multiple files at once as documented for Markor.
actions: tap additional items to add them to the selection
use the select-all action in the contextual toolbar if required

features.name: Mark a file or folder as a favourite
features.description: Mark a file or folder as a favourite as documented for Markor.
actions: open the favourites view from the drawer or the folder shortcuts to reach it quickly

features.name: Sort the file list
features.description: Sort the file list as documented for Markor.
actions: tap the sort icon (or the overflow menu
choose the sort key (name, date modified, file size or file type)

features.name: Show or hide hidden files
features.description: Show or hide hidden files as documented for Markor.

features.name: Jump to a specific folder path
features.description: Jump to a specific folder path as documented for Markor.
actions: choose a preset location (notebook, internal storage, SD card, app data, recent or popular documents) or type a path

features.name: View recent and popular documents
features.description: View recent and popular documents as documented for Markor.
actions: tap a listed file to reopen it

features.name: View file information
features.description: View file information as documented for Markor.
actions: read the path, size, modification date and permissions

features.name: Encrypt and open password-protected notes
features.description: Encrypt and open password-protected notes as documented for Markor.
actions: set the encryption password under the encryption/security section
create or open a file with the encrypted (.jenc) extension
edit the decrypted content as usual

features.name: Open a file with another application
features.description: Open a file with another application as documented for Markor.
actions: select the external app from the chooser

features.name: Add a launcher shortcut to a document
features.description: Add a launcher shortcut to a document as documented for Markor.
actions: confirm the placement on the Android home screen

features.name: Add the Markor home screen widget
features.description: Add the Markor home screen widget as documented for Markor.
actions: Long-press an empty area of the Android home screen
drag the widget onto the home screen
choose the folder or file it should open

features.name: Change the notebook (root) directory
features.description: Change the notebook (root) directory as documented for Markor.
actions: browse to the folder to use

features.name: Change the theme and colours
features.description: Change the theme and colours as documented for Markor.
actions: choose light, dark or system default
set the editor background and accent colour options

features.name: Change the editor font family and size
features.description: Change the editor font family and size as documented for Markor.
actions: tap the font family entry to pick a font
tap the font size entry and set the value

features.name: Configure editor behaviour
features.description: Configure editor behaviour as documented for Markor.
actions: toggle options such as line numbers, syntax highlighting, word wrap, auto-format, tab width, keep screen on, and highlighting delay

features.name: Configure the format action bar buttons
features.description: Configure the format action bar buttons as documented for Markor.
actions: enable, disable or reorder the individual formatting actions shown above the keyboard

features.name: Change the app language
features.description: Change the app language as documented for Markor.
actions: choose the interface language from the list
the app reloads in that language

features.name: Review the changelog, help and licences
features.description: Review the changelog, help and licences as documented for Markor.
actions: Open Settings or the overflow menu
read the changelog, the built-in help pages, the open-source licences and the version number
